decision_origins_confidence_range.name: decision_origins_confidence_range
decision_origins_confidence_range.value: confidence IS NULL OR (confidence >= 0 AND confidence <= 1)

decisions_status_snapshot_check.name: decisions_status_snapshot_check
decisions_status_snapshot_check.value: (status = 'draft' AND confirmed_snapshot IS NULL AND confirmed_at IS NULL) OR (status IN ('confirmed','closed') AND confirmed_snapshot IS NOT NULL AND confirmed_at IS NOT NULL)

review_dimensions_score_range.name: review_dimensions_score_range
review_dimensions_score_range.value: score IS NULL OR (score >= 0 AND score <= 100)

review_dimensions_confidence_range.name: review_dimensions_confidence_range
review_dimensions_confidence_range.value: confidence IS NULL OR (confidence >= 0 AND confidence <= 1)

trades_closed_after_open.name: trades_closed_after_open
trades_closed_after_open.value: closed_at IS NULL OR closed_at >= opened_at

trades_bitget_execution_required.name: trades_bitget_execution_required
trades_bitget_execution_required.value: provider <> 'bitget' OR (quantity IS NOT NULL AND entry_price IS NOT NULL AND opened_at IS NOT NULL)

patterns_confidence_range.name: patterns_confidence_range
patterns_confidence_range.value: confidence IS NULL OR (confidence >= 0 AND confidence <= 1)

playbook_rules_status_decision_check.name: playbook_rules_status_decision_check
playbook_rules_status_decision_check.value: (status = 'proposed' AND user_decision IS NULL AND decided_at IS NULL) OR (status = 'active' AND user_decision IS NOT NULL AND user_decision = 'accepted' AND decided_at IS NOT NULL) OR (status = 'rejected' AND user_decision IS NOT NULL AND user_decision = 'rejected' AND decided_at IS NOT NULL) OR (status = 'deferred' AND user_decision IS NOT NULL AND user_decision = 'deferred' AND decided_at IS NOT NULL)

evidence_records_kind_reference_check.name: evidence_records_kind_reference_check
evidence_records_kind_reference_check.value:
(
        (kind IN ('user_input','prior_decision') AND decision_id IS NOT NULL AND context_snapshot_id IS NULL AND trade_id IS NULL AND source_id IS NULL AND review_id IS NULL AND rule_id IS NULL) OR
        (kind = 'market_data' AND context_snapshot_id IS NOT NULL AND decision_id IS NULL AND trade_id IS NULL AND source_id IS NULL AND review_id IS NULL AND rule_id IS NULL) OR
        (kind = 'trade_data' AND trade_id IS NOT NULL AND decision_id IS NULL AND context_snapshot_id IS NULL AND source_id IS NULL AND review_id IS NULL AND rule_id IS NULL) OR
        (kind = 'source' AND source_id IS NOT NULL AND decision_id IS NULL AND context_snapshot_id IS NULL AND trade_id IS NULL AND review_id IS NULL AND rule_id IS NULL) OR
        (kind = 'prior_review' AND review_id IS NOT NULL AND decision_id IS NULL AND context_snapshot_id IS NULL AND trade_id IS NULL AND source_id IS NULL AND rule_id IS NULL) OR
        (kind = 'playbook_rule' AND rule_id IS NOT NULL AND decision_id IS NULL AND context_snapshot_id IS NULL AND trade_id IS NULL AND source_id IS NULL AND review_id IS NULL)
      )

memory_embeddings_entity_check.name: memory_embeddings_entity_check
memory_embeddings_entity_check.value:
(
        (entity_type = 'decision' AND decision_id IS NOT NULL AND decision_id = entity_id AND review_id IS NULL AND pattern_id IS NULL AND rule_id IS NULL) OR
        (entity_type = 'review' AND review_id IS NOT NULL AND review_id = entity_id AND decision_id IS NULL AND pattern_id IS NULL AND rule_id IS NULL) OR
        (entity_type = 'pattern' AND pattern_id IS NOT NULL AND pattern_id = entity_id AND decision_id IS NULL AND review_id IS NULL AND rule_id IS NULL) OR
        (entity_type = 'rule' AND rule_id IS NOT NULL AND rule_id = entity_id AND decision_id IS NULL AND review_id IS NULL AND pattern_id IS NULL)
      )

spot_activities_pair_check.name: spot_activities_pair_check
spot_activities_pair_check.value: base_asset ~ '^[A-Z0-9][A-Z0-9._-]{0,29}$' AND quote_asset ~ '^[A-Z0-9][A-Z0-9._-]{0,29}$' AND base_asset <> quote_asset AND trading_pair = base_asset || '/' || quote_asset

spot_activity_events_shape_check.name: spot_activity_events_shape_check
spot_activity_events_shape_check.value:
(
        (event_type = 'source_snapshot' AND import_id IS NOT NULL AND event_version IS NULL) OR
        (event_type = 'purpose_change' AND import_id IS NULL AND event_version IS NOT NULL AND event_version >= 1)
      )

spot_activity_events_snapshot_data_check.name: spot_activity_events_snapshot_data_check
spot_activity_events_snapshot_data_check.value: event_type <> 'source_snapshot' OR COALESCE(data->>'parserVersion' = 'bitget_classic_spot_order_history.v1' AND data->>'sourceHash' ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND jsonb_typeof(data->'order') = 'object' AND jsonb_typeof(data->'executionKeys') = 'array', false)

spot_activity_events_purpose_data_check.name: spot_activity_events_purpose_data_check
spot_activity_events_purpose_data_check.value: event_type <> 'purpose_change' OR COALESCE(data->>'purpose' IN ('speculative_trade','payment_conversion','other_nontrading','unknown') AND data->>'basis' = 'user_declared' AND (data ? 'reason'), false)

spot_csv_imports_counts_check.name: spot_csv_imports_counts_check
spot_csv_imports_counts_check.value: order_count BETWEEN 1 AND 1000 AND execution_count BETWEEN 0 AND 10000

spot_executions_amounts_check.name: spot_executions_amounts_check
spot_executions_amounts_check.value: price > 0 AND quantity > 0 AND gross_volume > 0 AND fee_amount >= 0
